'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Armenian coup d'état attempt]], [[2020−2021 Armenian protests]]
**Protesters storm a [[government of Armenia|government]] building in [[Yerevan]], [[Armenia]], to demand [[Prime Minister of Armenia|Prime Minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]]'s resignation. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/1/armenian-protesters-break-into-government-building-report (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|War in Donbass]]
**[[Ukraine]] reports multiple [[Minsk Protocol|ceasefire]] violations, with one casualty. [https://www.unian.info/war/donbas-war-update-ukraine-reports-one-kia-on-feb-28-11337422.html  (UNIAN)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**[[BBC]] reporter Girmay Gebru is detained by Ethiopian soldiers along with four other people in [[Mekelle]], [[Tigray Region|Tigray]], and they are sent to a military camp for unknown reasons. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-56246834 (BBC News)]
*[[Operation Madago Raya]]
**A gunfight erupts between [[Indonesian Army]] and [[East Indonesia Mujahideen]] in the Andole Mountain area, [[Poso Regency]], [[Central Sulawesi]], resulting in the death of a soldier and two militants. [https://kailipost.com/2021/03/kontak-tembak-dua-dpo-mit-tewas-dan-satu-anggota-satgas-meninggal.html (Kaili Post)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**The [[Special Inspector General for Afghanistan Reconstruction]] releases a report accusing the [[United States]] of wasting billions of dollars in [[Afghanistan]] on buildings and vehicles that were either abandoned or destroyed. The agency says only $343.2 million worth of vehicles and buildings were in good condition. [https://www.voanews.com/usa/report-us-wasted-billions-dollars-afghan-rebuilding-projects (VOA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three members of the Panamanian diplomatic corps in [[Colombia]] are killed after the overflow of the [[Río Frío (Bogotá savanna)|Río Frío]] drags the vehicle they were traveling in. [https://www.infobae.com/america/colombia/2021/03/02/consul-de-panama-en-colombia-su-esposo-y-otra-persona-murieron-por-creciente-de-rio-en-el-huila/ (Infobae)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****[[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] receives his first dose of the [[Bharat Biotech]] [[BBV152|Covaxin]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/pm-narendra-modi-gets-first-shot-of-bharat-biotech-s-covaxin-at-aiims-101614565374515.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
*****The [[Philippines]] begins its vaccination campaign against [[COVID-19]] using the [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] vaccine donated by China, with the first doses administered to [[Health professional|healthcare workers]] in [[Metro Manila]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-03-01/philippines-begins-vaccinations-with-china-donated-sinovac-shots (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]]
****[[Jordan]] approves the emergency use of the single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] vaccine. [https://en.royanews.tv/news/25919/2021-03-01 (Roya News English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Syria]]
****[[Syria]] begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19. Medical health workers are the first to receive the vaccine. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-syria-vaccine/syria-begins-covid-19-vaccinations-with-healthcare-workers-idUKKCN2AT1TY (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] begins a stricter nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] announced by [[Prime Minister of the Czech Republic|Prime Minister]] [[Andrej Babiš]] last week with more police officers and soldiers deployed to enforce the restrictions. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-03-01/czechs-tighten-covid-lockdown-seek-more-tests-for-factory-workers (U.S. News and World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] raises age limit for those who receive [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] vaccine to those aged below 75. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20210301-france-eases-ban-on-astrazeneca-s-covid-19-vaccine-for-over-65s (France 24)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Finland]]
****[[Finland]] declares a [[state of emergency]] amidst an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [[Prime Minister of Finland|Prime Minister]] [[Sanna Marin]] says that the emergency controls will allow the [[Government of Finland|government]] to close schools and restaurants and limit movement between [[Regions of Finland|regions]]. [https://www.euroweeklynews.com/2021/03/01/finland-declares-state-of-emergency-over-rising-covid-cases/ (Euro Weekly News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Slovakia]] receives the first shipment consisting 200,000 doses of [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V]] vaccine as it signed an agreement to secure two million doses. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/03/01/slovakia-receives-200-000-doses-of-russia-s-sputnik-v-coronavirus-vaccine (Euronews)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ghana]]
****[[President of Ghana|President]] [[Nana Akufo-Addo]], [[Vice President of Ghana|Vice President]] [[Mahamudu Bawumia]], and their spouses receive their first doses of the vaccine from the [[COVAX]] initiative as [[Ghana]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19. [https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/world-56235713 (BBC Pidgin)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ivory Coast]]
****[[Ivory Coast]] begins its mass vaccination campaign against COVID-19 using the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine delivered by the [[COVAX]] initiative. [[Health worker]]s, teachers, and members of the [[armed forces]] are the first to receive the vaccine. [https://apnews.com/article/health-coronavirus-pandemic-abidjan-africa-west-africa-ee77cd5f8aa5e1051e9eaddab0b6c542 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]]
****[[President of Zimbabwe|President]] [[Emmerson Mnangagwa]] announces a slight easing of the lockdown in [[Zimbabwe]] amidst a decline in the number of COVID-19 cases. Intercity travel is resumed, and small and large businesses have been allowed to reopen. [https://ewn.co.za/2021/03/01/emmerson-mnangagwa-relaxes-lockdown-in-zimbabwe (EWN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****It is reported that former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and his wife [[Melania Trump]] have received a dose of the COVID-19 vaccine at the [[White House]] prior to their departure on January 20. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2021/03/01/coronavirus-covid-live-updates-us/ (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Florida]] reports its first case of the 501.V2 variant first detected in [[South Africa]]. [https://www.clickorlando.com/news/local/2021/03/01/first-case-of-south-african-covid-19-variant-confirmed-in-florida/ (Clickorlando.com)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela]]
***[[Venezuela]] approves the emergency use of [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] vaccine. [https://www.elcomercio.com/actualidad/venezuela-autorizacion-vacuna-china-sinopharm.html (''El Comercio'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Aftermath of the [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]], [[2021 Myanmar protests]]
**Ousted leader [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] appears in court to hear two more charges against her. The charges are a colonial-era penal code prohibiting publication of information that may "cause fear or alarm", and a telecommunications law stipulating licenses for equipment. Meanwhile, police disperse protesters with tear gas and stun grenades. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-politics/myanmar-court-files-more-charges-against-suu-kyi-police-crack-down-on-protests-idUSKCN2AS0P4?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Onești stabbing]]
**Two workers are stabbed to death during a [[hostage]]-taking incident in an apartment building in [[Onești]], [[Romania]]. The attacker, a man in his 60s, had a 12-year dispute with the company that was running the building, of which he was the former owner. [https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/evenimente/imagini-cu-agresorul-de-la-onesti-a-iesit-la-balcon-fluturand-cutitul-in-timp-ce-negocia-cu-politia-1460767 (Digi 24)]
*[[Nicolas Sarkozy corruption trial]]
**Former [[French President]] [[Nicolas Sarkozy]] is sentenced to three years in jail for [[corruption in France|corruption]], after being found guilty of trying to offer a job to a [[magistrate]] in return for information about a criminal inquiry into his [[political party]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-56237818 (BBC News)]
*[[Barçagate]]
**Former [[List of FC Barcelona presidents|president of FC Barcelona]] [[Josep Maria Bartomeu]] is arrested while [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] search the [[FC Barcelona]] offices. Three other senior staff members are also arrested. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2021/mar/01/police-raid-barcelonas-camp-nou-in-search-and-seize-operation (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2021 Texas power crisis]], [[February 13–17, 2021 North American winter storm]]
**[[Texas Attorney General]] [[Ken Paxton]] files a lawsuit against [[Griddy]], accusing them of charging Texans "outrageous amounts" after the winter storm that resulted in power outages for millions in the [[Texas|state]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/power-provider-griddy-sued-texas-ag-after-billing-outrageous-amounts-following-storm-1572837 (''Newsweek'')]
